correctness.rationale: Genus by tame branch RH; valuations give four-dimensional regular differential basis. Exact Cartier semilinear relations yield \(\mathcal C^2(u)=H^{1/25}u\) and stable rank exactly 0/2. H coefficient expansion checked symbolically in actual verifier; primitive quadratic in a0 has specialized nonsquare discriminant a3^8(a3²+3), proving absolute irreducibility via UFD and Gauss. Two smooth witnesses show divisor nonempty/proper; independent GF25 point-count congruences for all 2500 smooth F5 models corroborate, not replace, proof.

value.rationale: The full standard genus-four cyclic quintic family admits an explicit natural 5-rank invariant in all five coefficients, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Weighted-degree-16 irreducible hypersurface gives an exact coordinate-level classification and an independently proved irreducible marked zero-rank locus. This is not merely the previously known abstract-moduli irreducibility result. It can guide exact arithmetic stratification and examples without promising unproved downstream theorems.
